verdict.rationale: Smart Capture Link is documented as a low- to no-code frontend: Entrust hosts the verification journey and the link is sent to customers, redirecting them into the workflow. Workflow Studio lets teams build that workflow with no-code drag-and-drop and no developer involvement. Missing for 10: any mention of QR code delivery, documentation of an ops user generating or sending a one-off link from the Dashboard without API setup (the docs say "low- to no-code" and "with or without engineering effort"), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
